text:
elaine-sales: Starting thread for MercuryTrust POC. Requirements: Okta SSO (SAML), SCIM for ~60k users, nested groups, RBAC per subsidiary, strict domain lock to bank domains only. Key asks: SCIM throughput, provisioning audit logs, KMS support, and pricing if Dedicated required.

sam-se: I can lead SE. Clarify: delta sync target? delegated admins? JIT needed?

elaine-sales: From kickoff call: delta for critical groups ~<5m, bulk hourly. Delegated admins across 4 subsidiaries. Prefer SCIM for provisioning; some partner apps want SAML attribute maps.

priya-ml: Note: 60k near-real-time pushes will likely require higher provisioning throughput and caching on our side. We should propose a POC Dedicated with autoscale guardrails.

aaron-se: For RBAC, we can map SAML claims to roles and SCIM groups to roles. Need the department_code attribute and nested group handling. I'll draft mapping template.

devops-bot: Provision command: /deploy poc-mercury --env staging --dedicated 2xgpus --retain 24h

sam-se: Domain proof options: DNS TXT preferred for automation; we also support email validation. Recommend DNS for multiple subdomains.

elaine-sales: Security RFP asks: admin MFA, KMS integration (AWS/GCP), SCIM audit logs (actor+timestamp), SOC2. Legal: any issues?

legal: No blockers. Need to verify KMS connectors and add DPA/SCC notes for EU. Also confirm data residency region.

sam-se: Proposed SCIM rate limits for POC: 12 req/s steady, burst to 60 for 3m windows. Recommend client backoff sample: HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 30

priya-ml: Pricing: if Dedicated required, expect ~2.5x unit cost vs hosted for this workload. Ask finance for POC month commitment discount.

elaine-sales: Action items: 1) @sam-se produce SCIM schema & mapping template by EOD tomorrow. 2) @priya-ml perf+cost estimate. 3) @legal send KMS compatibility checklist to customer. 4) @devops-bot provision staging once SE signs off.

aaron-se: Starting mapping draft now. Example SCIM push snippet included in my draft.

elaine-sales: Thanks team — will update customer after mapping + KMS check confirmed. :thumbsup:
